rules: Do not map queue.taskLinks directly to recommendations: sourceLinkConfirmed only proves a reference, not content suitability.
Never expose excludedOrUnconfirmedLinks as related tasks; many are request IDs auto-linked as knowledge IDs.
lessonLinks and hubLinks are concept/navigation references, not tasks.
P06 has no verified external task; its in-document CRUD practice remains the only confirmed practice label.
P16→1-2 is a date/time-contract source link. Show the actual current task title and retain section scope.
search-index.relatedTasks is the restricted, explicitly curated UI list; do not expand it to every queue link automatically.

nonMarkdownLinkInvestigation.finding: Generated visual component link, not a Markdown source link
nonMarkdownLinkInvestigation.recommendation: Keep provenance as visual-component navigation; do not promote into curated related task automatically.

nonMarkdownLinkInvestigation.finding: Bare W20 mention in source row R4 gets auto-linked; a separate full Markdown W20 reference on the same page already exists
nonMarkdownLinkInvestigation.recommendation: Do not duplicate the auto-link as independent relationship evidence; retain the explicit named heading link with its section scope.

followupMissionCount.decision: tickets5 belongs to attached source snapshot, not current local inventory; future mission design must rescan local 30 tickets, preserving dataset distinctions

baselineDomIdAudit.basis: Python HTMLParser; original source XML code separately checked for known escaped id attribute

filesChanged: only this research validation JSON; repository sources/code/generated files unchanged by this validation
integrationNotes: Use primaryDomain/categoryId delivery for the fourth category. Original draft controller used design.

Web href starts #/ because the handoff artifact has an embedded route model. This static local site has no such hash router: generate a relative href from route, retain the decoded original anchor, and do not directly transplant href.
Only 4 search-index relatedTasks pairs are curated. Queue sourceLinkConfirmed entries prove a reference, not a fully reviewed recommendation.
Preserve queue coverage fullDocumentReviewed=0 and individualLearningVisualizationImplemented=0. Do not claim all 134 technical examples are verified.
